info.name: Boudica Code
info.summary: In-browser code editor with project file management and AI chat, backed by your Nextcloud files.
info.description: Boudica Code is a standalone Nextcloud app providing a VS Code-style three-pane workspace: a Monaco-based text editor, a file/project tree backed by WebDAV, and a chat panel for issuing commands (create file, open file, run task, etc.) to the Boudica backend.
info.author: You
